logo.label: Footer logo
logo.doc: The lockup across the foot of every page. It is artwork, not type — the words behind it exist only as the name a screen reader reads out.

logo_width.label: Footer logo width
logo_width.doc: How wide the footer logo is, in pixels. 120 to 960 — the stylesheet also wraps it in "or 62% of the screen, whichever is smaller", so a big number still cannot overflow a phone. The logo keeps its own proportions, so any shape of logo works and the height follows the width.

logo_href.label: Footer logo links to
logo_href.doc: Where clicking it goes. Leave empty and it is not a link at all.

pad_top.label: Space above
pad_top.doc: The breathing room between the last section and the footer, in pixels.

pad_bottom.label: Space below
pad_bottom.doc: The room under the lockup before the page ends.

align.label: Logo alignment
align.doc: Where the logo sits. The small print, legal links and social icons are placed separately, in the groups below.

legal.label: Small print
legal.doc: The copyright line at the foot of every page. Type {year} anywhere in it and the current year is filled in automatically — you never have to come back in January. Leave empty for no small print at all.
legal.default: © {year} Blacktop Restaurant Group. All rights reserved.

legal_align.label: Small print sits (computer)
legal_align.doc: Where the copyright line goes on a computer screen: the left, middle or right end of the bottom row.

legal_align_m.label: Small print sits (phone)
legal_align_m.doc: Where the copyright line goes on a phone. On a phone the small print, legal links and social icons stack in a column, in that order, and each one lines up left, center or right as chosen here.

legal_links.label: Legal links
legal_links.doc: One row per link, shown in a line with very small, bold, underlined text, the same size as the small print. In each row type the words, then choose where it goes: paste a web address, or search for one of your pages. Drag the rows to reorder them.

label.label: What the link says
label.doc: The words people see, for example Privacy Policy.

link.label: Where it goes
link.doc: Click Select Link, then either paste a web address or search for one of your pages.

links_pos.label: Legal links sit (computer)
links_pos.doc: Which end of the bottom row the legal links go in on a computer screen.

links_pos_m.label: Legal links sit (phone)
links_pos_m.doc: How the legal links line up on a phone.

show_social.label: Social icons
show_social.doc: Master switch for the icons at the foot. The web addresses come from Brand info (or the Social menu if one is missing there), so hiding them here leaves those alone.

social_size.label: Social icon size
social_size.doc: How big each icon is, in pixels.

social_instagram.label: Instagram icon
social_instagram.doc: Show the Instagram icon. It only appears if a Instagram address is saved on Brand info (or in the Social menu).

social_linkedin.label: LinkedIn icon
social_linkedin.doc: Show the LinkedIn icon. It only appears if a LinkedIn address is saved on Brand info (or in the Social menu).

social_facebook.label: Facebook icon
social_facebook.doc: Show the Facebook icon. It only appears if a Facebook address is saved on Brand info (or in the Social menu).

social_tiktok.label: TikTok icon
social_tiktok.doc: Show the TikTok icon. It only appears if a TikTok address is saved on Brand info (or in the Social menu).

social_pos.label: Social icons sit (computer)
social_pos.doc: Which end of the bottom row the icons go in on a computer screen.

social_pos_m.label: Social icons sit (phone)
social_pos_m.doc: How the icons line up on a phone.
